claim_one_line: LEVEL 5'S WEIL REPRESENTATION LIES IN SU(3) x SU(2), THE HAND IS THE GOLDEN FIELD'S QUADRATIC CHARACTER, AND THE LEPTON COPY HAPPENS EXACTLY AT ORDERS DIVIDING 5: both Weil representations of SL(2, F5) on C^5 split invariantly as an even icosahedral triplet (real, golden traces, in SO(3)) and the odd spinor doublet (in SU(2)), determinant 1 on each; the hand (-1)^(n+e) of +-J^n K^e is the Legendre symbol mod 5 of its eigenvalue at the mark, the quadratic character of Q(sqrt 5), on all 32 elements; with the frame's charges the lepton pair is the down pair transposed modulo N exactly when N divides 5 (hypercharge mod 5 is SU(5)'s centre), so the leptons separate only through a line or level with another prime (consolidating B1728, P-355, P-384).
